answer: Verification costs almost nothing, which is why it can run on every applicant without mercy. One mask pays 67 POA and waits 8 days; a farm pays 51791 POA and still waits 8 days per mask. Hand the panel a comet it can verify, a cedar it can count, and a nectar it can date, and the panel will do the rest. I trust a proof that lives outside the applicant's hands, and Quill cutter gilded leaf proof illumined in the bishop's court is that proof: each gilded leaf is a season of logged illumination tests plus a signed vellum record.
